content.name: Harriet Ashworth
profile: Marketing manager with nine years' experience across B2B software and professional services in the North West of England. Specialises in demand generation, marketing automation and turning a small budget into a measurable pipeline.
Recently relocated to Dublin and available at short notice.

details: Dissertation on trust signals in B2B landing pages

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Owned the marketing plan and a budget of £320k for a 90-person accounting software vendor, reporting to the commercial director.
Grew marketing-sourced pipeline from 18% to 41% of new business over three years through a webinar programme and targeted LinkedIn campaigns.
Migrated the company from Pardot to HubSpot, rebuilding every nurture sequence and lead scoring model in the process.
Managed two executives and an external content agency, and organised the annual customer conference for 300 attendees.

experience.title: Marketing Executive
bullets: Ran email, social and events for a regional accountancy and advisory firm with six offices.
Launched the firm's first podcast, which reached 2,000 downloads an episode within a year.
Role made redundant during the firm's merger; left on good terms with a reference available.

experience.title: Marketing Assistant
bullets: Supported account managers on paid search and social campaigns for a dozen SME clients.
Wrote monthly performance reports and presented them to clients alongside the account lead.

additional: Eligible to work in Ireland and the UK without sponsorship
Interests: fell running, restoring a narrowboat
